task: Evaluate the 5-pillar research dossier for Health Agent System (Metabolic Contour) and formulate a definitive, prioritized implementation and validation plan. The evaluation covers: 1) Hardware/API plugins, 2) Clinical AI skills & dual-system architecture, 3) Endocrinology and metabolic mathematics (Hall, Pontzer, Alpert, MATADOR), 4) Open-source computation engines (PMC, PK, PuLP), 5) Behavioral psychology & adherence telemetry (CBT-E, ACT, Binge Risk Triad).
constraints: Strict hardware limitation: Debian Linux, 1 vCPU, 1 GB RAM, SQLite. Zero local heavy ML/DL (no local Whisper, PaddleOCR, Torch, Transformers, or YASA).
Clinical target: Single user on Tirzepatide (GIP/GLP-1), massive fat loss with mandatory preservation of Lean Body Mass (LBM). Protein 1.6-2.2 g/kg FFM.
Zero-math LLM policy: LLM performs only semantic NLU and empathetic coaching; all calculations and guardrails are 100% deterministic Python with Pydantic V2 schemas.
Address core bug fixes: inverted sign in adaptive_tdee, Alpert constant unit error (31 kcal/lb vs 69.3 kcal/kg), sex-blind FFMI and essential fat floors, LBM drift direction check.

Structure requirements: Planner must include # Plan, ## Overview, ## Scope, ## Phases, ## Testing Strategy, ## Risks, ## Rollback Plan, ## Edge Cases. Judge must include # Judge Report, ## Scores, ## Comparative Analysis, ## Missing Steps, ## Contradictions, ## Improvements, ## Final Plan.

repo_context.notes: Base all decisions on the detailed research reports in research/ directory.
